([[Sugar Hill, Georgia]]) | college = *[[Tulane Green Wave men's basketball|Tulane]] (2020–2024) *[[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] (2024–2025) | highlights = * [[Atlantic Coast Conference|ACC]] All-Defensive team (2025) }} '''Sion James''' (born December 4, 2002) is an American [[basketball]] player. He played [[college basketball]] player for the [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke Blue Devils]] and the [[Tulane Green Wave men's basketball|Tulane Green Wave]]. ==Early life and high school== James grew up in [[Sugar Hill, Georgia]] and attended [[Lanier High School (Sugar Hill, Georgia)|Lanier High School]].{{cite web|url=https://www.gwinnettdailypost.com/sports/prep/sion-james-serious-about-leading-lanier-in-senior-season/article_b3fe39d6-7452-5e42-b2d9-1e9efd4ad304.html|title=Sion James serious about leading Lanier in senior season|work=[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]|date=January 30, 2020|access-date=October 11, 2024}} He averaged 14.6 points, 6.1 rebounds, and 5.3 assists per game as a junior.{{cite web|url=https://tulanegreenwave.com/news/2019/11/18/mens-basketball-adds-sion-james-to-signing-class|title=Men’s Basketball Adds Sion James to Signing Class|website=TulaneGreenWave.com|date=November 18, 2019|access-date=October 13, 2024}} James committed to play [[college basketball]] at [[Tulane Green Wave men's basketball|Tulane]].{{cite web|url=https://www.gwinnettdailypost.com/sports/prep/tulane-mens-basketball-lands-commitment-from-lanier-guard-sion-james/article_3f1a988b-fb6d-5a1f-a610-7c311d883426.html|title=Tulane men's basketball lands commitment from Lanier guard Sion James|work=[[Gwinnett Daily Post]]|date=September 2, 2019|access-date=October 11, 2024}} ==College career== James began his college career at [[Tulane Green Wave men's basketball|Tulane]].{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/tulane/tulanes-sion-james-has-top-assistturnover-ratio-in-d-i/article_c23ec500-7d90-11ed-b1b8-ff3fa604a14a.html|title=Tulane's Sion James has top assist/turnover ratio in D-I|work=[[The Times-Picayune]]|date=December 16, 2022|access-date=October 15, 2024}} He became a starter early into his freshman year.{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/tulane/mature-beyond-his-years-tulane-freshman-sion-james-is-rounding-into-form/article_37399e76-60f0-11eb-b121-33567f07e85b.html|title=Mature beyond his years, Tulane freshman Sion James is rounding into form|work=[[The Times-Picayune]]|date=January 27, 2021|access-date=October 14, 2024}} James averaged 5.8 points, 3.5 rebounds, 1.9 assists, and 1.2 steals per game on the season.{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/tulane/still-excited-tulane-mens-basketball-coach-ron-hunter-expects-huge-improvement-in-year-3/article_c8997240-215e-11ec-9692-cbfdeac32160.html|title=Still excited: Tulane men's basketball coach Ron Hunter expects huge improvement in year 3|first=Guerry|last=Smith|work=[[The Times-Picayune]]|date=September 29, 2021|access-date=October 14, 2024}} He averaged 9.7 points, 3.4 assists, and 4.8 rebounds per game as a junior and also won the [[American Athletic Conference]] (AAC) sportsmanship award.{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/tulane/three-returning-stalwarts-highlight-tulane-hoops-roster/article_5d48e980-0b09-11ee-8ef4-17732c19b5ff.html|title=Three returning stalwarts highlight Tulane hoops roster|first=Guerry|last=Smith|work=[[The Times-Picayune]]|date=June 14, 2023|access-date=October 14, 2024}} He averaged 14 points, 5.4 rebounds, 2.7 assists, and 1.6 steals per game during his senior season and again won the AAC sportsmanship award.{{cite web|url=https://www.cbssports.com/college-basketball/news/college-basketball-rankings-dukes-addition-of-sion-james-moves-blue-devils-up-in-top-25-and-1/|title=College basketball rankings: Duke's addition of Sion James moves Blue Devils up in Top 25 And 1|first=Gary|last=Parrish|website=[[CBS Sports]]|date=May 11, 2024|access-date=October 15, 2024}} After the season, James entered the NCAA transfer portal.{{cite web|url=https://www.nola.com/sports/tulane/tulane-guard-sion-james-to-transfer-to-duke/article_d1a180b0-0f06-11ef-b854-e79fce07f6fa.html|title=Tulane basketball is losing a transfer to an ACC powerhouse program|work=[[The Times-Picayune]]|date=May 10, 2024|access-date=October 14, 2024}} James transferred to [[Duke Blue Devils men's basketball|Duke]] in May 2024.{{cite web|url=https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/5484493/2024/05/10/duke-basketball-sion-james-transfer-portal/|title=Duke lands Tulane transfer Sion James, likely rounding out Blue Devils’ 2024-25 rotation|first=Brendan|last=Marks|website=[[The Athletic]]|date=May 10, 2024|access-date=October 11, 2024}} ==References== {{reflist}} ==External links==
